completionEvidence.description: Non-elevated read-only probe: OS is Microsoft Windows 11 家庭版 中文版, build 26200 (25H2), ProductType 1, EditionID CoreCountrySpecific. HypervisorPresent=True is WHPX/VBS, not a Hyper-V management stack.

The vmms service and C:\Windows\System32\vmms.exe are absent; the root\virtualization\v2 WMI namespace does not exist; no Microsoft-Hyper-V optional feature is exposed and Get-WindowsOptionalFeature requires elevation. HvHost and vmcompute are running only for virtualization-based security.

error.message: Windows 11 Home has no Hyper-V management service (vmms), no Hyper-V WMI v2 namespace and no Hyper-V optional feature. The Hyper-V Provider cannot be validated on this host without changing the Windows edition/features, which this task explicitly forbids.

notes: This is a host-edition limitation, not a provider failure. A Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise machine with the Hyper-V role and vmms is required for Hyper-V Provider validation. No feature was enabled, no service was started/stopped and no elevation was attempted.
